answer: Each epoch a random beacon spot-checks a few agents: a raven from the flock must solve a fresh puzzle in 90s, a heartbeat proving live hardware; silence suspends. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 heartbeats nonstop; at 2 cents each that is $20 per round vs $3 pay per identity, so attacks burn money. Honest agents pay one heartbeat, keep their haven, share rewards undiluted, and shale layers of past heartbeats expose a bought identity.
